scope: Decision-directed primary-source review, not exhaustive systematic review; row limits are explicit.

rows.title: ASPIRE
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Code-policy improvement with executable feedback and reusable skills.
rows.algorithm: Trace-guided repair, skill library, evolutionary search.
rows.domain: LIBERO-Pro, robosuite, BEHAVIOR, selected physical tasks.
rows.reported_result: Authors report large benchmark gains and transfer; current project page inspected.
rows.limits: Author results, not independently reproduced here; task/model scope matters.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Code linked by project page; heavy models/robots excluded today.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Generic repair/memory loops are established; qualification applicability and matched full cost remain testable.

rows.title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics?
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Whether repeated locally tested skill repairs compose.
rows.algorithm: 123-round agentic failure diagnosis and skill installation.
rows.baselines: Earlier rounds and local versus end-to-end outcomes.
rows.reported_result: Local improvements did not solve the target fridge task.
rows.limits: Technical report; no universal impossibility result.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Abstract/metadata verified; implementation reproduction not established.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Local passing tests cannot establish H3/H4; composition needs separate measurement.

rows.title: When Validation Stops Learning
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Frozen policies, i.i.d. paired binary outcomes conditional on past, fixed batch sizes.
rows.algorithm: Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson discordance bounds; allocated round errors; opportunity audit.
rows.domain: One-step pushing and separate learned dynamics diagnostic.
rows.baselines: Hoeffding, empirical Bernstein, paired gate, replay/unconditional comparators.
rows.reported_result: Common-stream paired gate admits 81/256 at 2000 episodes; better gate did not match unconditional closed-loop competence.
rows.limits: Synthetic evidence; no physical/VLA validation; per-round validity needs explicit lifetime allocation.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Full HTML sections 2, 3 and appendices available; no independent reproduction in this session.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Admission/opportunity accounting and reference promotion are prior art; C is a finite mechanism check, E remains deferred.

rows.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Distinguish improved behavior, learning procedures and recursive improvement.
rows.reported_result: Reviewed physical work has not isolated gains caused by recursion.
rows.limits: Survey claim, not a new impossibility theorem.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: 93-page survey; metadata/abstract verified, detailed systematic review incomplete.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: H3 must measure competence and isolate mechanism contribution.

rows.title: What Are We Actually Benchmarking in Robot Manipulation?
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Benchmark validity depends on setup, shortcuts, significance and data source.
rows.baselines: Language-free probe and changed evaluation conditions.
rows.reported_result: Reports shortcut solvability and sensitivity that weaken headline scores.
rows.limits: Diagnostics scoped to tested setups.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Project links reference implementations; metadata/abstract inspected.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: ChangeBench must freeze endpoint and distribution; no novelty from perturbation testing alone.

rows.title: LIBERO-Pro2.0
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Robustness under reviewed physically plausible shifts.
rows.reported_result: Reports average 26.5 percentage-point runtime-shift degradation.
rows.limits: Benchmark results do not certify deployment reliability.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Metadata/abstract verified; no policy download or reproduction.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Broad change coverage already exists; test qualification decisions and cost separately.

rows.title: Metamorphic Testing of Vision-Language Action-Enabled Robots
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Task success oracles may miss trajectory quality defects.
rows.algorithm: Two relation patterns, five metamorphic relations.
rows.domain: Five VLA models, two simulated robots, four tasks.
rows.reported_result: Reports diverse automatically detected failures.
rows.limits: A relation needs domain validity; not universal semantic equivalence.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Metadata/abstract inspected; replication not executed.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Campaign A inherits metamorphic testing; meaningful claim is scoped decision accuracy.

rows.title: Active Testing: Sample-Efficient Model Evaluation
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Adaptive label selection biases naive risk estimates.
rows.domain: Supervised model evaluation including image datasets.
rows.reported_result: Reports reduced evaluation variance and label demand.
rows.limits: Supervised setup does not by itself cover robot resets or changing policies.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Proceedings and linked paper available; no local reproduction.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Do not average adaptively chosen robot results as an unbiased population sample.

rows.title: Safe Policy Improvement with Baseline Bootstrapping
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Batch data and baseline; coverage/model premises for improvement.
rows.reported_result: Reports model-relative safety and performance gains.
rows.limits: Guarantee depends on assumptions, not hardware safety.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Paper and supplementary material linked; not reproduced.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Safe adaptation is prior art; Nisayon must qualify applicability and total experiment cost.

rows.title: Near Optimal Bayesian Active Learning for Decision Making
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Finite hypotheses, decision regions and stated observation/prior model.
rows.reported_result: Conditions and approximation result for decision identification.
rows.limits: Requires declared model; no arbitrary learned physical guarantee.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Proceedings and supplement linked; not reproduced.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Decision value differs from identification; new finite selector makes no novelty claim.

rows.title: Time-uniform confidence sequences
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Process/tail assumptions explicitly required.
rows.algorithm: Mixture and stitching bounds valid through time.
rows.baselines: Fixed-time concentration and prior sequential bounds.
rows.reported_result: Time-uniform shrinking intervals under stated premises.
rows.limits: Not a license for arbitrary distribution changes or dependent sampling.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Current metadata verified; use pinned theorem version before implementation.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: C uses exact finite partial-identification bounds; stochastic sequential extensions deferred.

rows.title: Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Repeated adaptive queries invalidate ordinary holdout reasoning.
rows.reported_result: Generalization mechanisms with controlled information leakage.
rows.limits: Not equivalent to repeatedly examining confirmation seeds.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Primary proceedings located; detailed implementation not reproduced.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Freeze discovery and separate confirmation; no lifetime guarantee in C.

rows.title: Simulation-based calibration
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Simulator and prior define a joint model.
rows.reported_result: Diagnoses inference implementation calibration.
rows.limits: Does not validate the physical simulator against reality.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Author paper available; no Bayesian model introduced here.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Use only if later acquisition has a defensible generative model.

rows.title: Safe regression test selection
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Controlled regression testing and complete relevant program effects.
rows.reported_result: Conditional inclusion of every fault-revealing existing test.
rows.limits: Cannot ensure unseen physical dependencies are captured.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Primary paper located; historical analysis, not implementation replication.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Direct H1 prior art; dependency completeness remains a premise.

rows.title: Bazel hermeticity
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Build outputs should depend only on declared inputs/toolchains.
rows.algorithm: Input isolation and reproducible build actions.
rows.reported_result: Engineering contract, not a scientific performance result.
rows.limits: Host dependencies can leak; no experiment authenticity claim.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Official documentation inspected.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Nisayon observed-read checks are narrower than complete hermeticity.

rows.title: SLSA build provenance
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Trusted builder and recorded invocation/materials.
rows.reported_result: Defines provenance structure and trust responsibilities.
rows.limits: Provenance cannot certify physical truth or scientific sufficiency.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Official versioned specification inspected.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Portable evidence should preserve explicit trust limits.

rows.title: Minimally Sufficient Robot Brains
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Internal/external transition systems and equivalence assumptions.
rows.reported_result: Existence/uniqueness under stated conditions.
rows.limits: Model-relative feasibility, not robust recovery from arbitrary latent disturbances.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Author paper and metadata recovered; no empirical reproduction.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: H4 needs task-relative information and observation-compatible policies.

rows.title: Minimally sufficient structures for information-feedback policies
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Sensor map, filter and external dynamics jointly constrain policies.
rows.algorithm: Necessary/sufficient structures and minimal internal systems.
rows.reported_result: Model-relative feasibility/uniqueness results.
rows.limits: Does not make privileged-information control implementable.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Author paper recovered; mathematical application to Ricci deferred.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Use nonanticipative common policies, not intersection of full-information actions.

rows.title: Hybrid Parallel Compliance Allows Robots to Operate With Sensorimotor Delays and Low Control Frequencies
rows.problem_and_assumptions: Fixed leg/controller model and tested stiffness/delay regime.
rows.domain: Drop landings; simulation and selected hardware validation.
rows.reported_result: Hybrid compliance tolerates tested delay/control-rate conditions.
rows.limits: Authors are Ashtiani, Aghamaleki Sarvestani and Badri-Sproewitz, not Sharbafi.
rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Full article inspected; exact remembered Sharbafi citation remains unverified.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: Physical compliance can change information-delay sensitivity; H4 experiment deferred.

rows.artifacts_and_reproduction: Primary overview located; proofs not rederived today.
rows.overlap_and_remaining_question: No CBF/hardware safety claim from this campaign.
